structure_note: The MAYA filer is Atrau Capital Markets (אטראו שוקי הון), whose only activity is a 50% equity-accounted stake in Yelin Lapidot Holdings. Each fact carries 'entity': 'atrau' = the filer's own consolidated statements (share of associate's profit, holding-company costs), 'yelin_lapidot' = the associate's own statements attached to the filing at 100% (Part D/F, page-cited in the same PDF). Neither entity prints an operating-segments note: Atrau states a single segment (investment management); Yelin Lapidot's revenue by activity is taken from its income statement as segment_revenue.
